highlights: Strict Admin vs Student notification role isolation & self-action suppression
Student Portal Screenshot Protection (Android FLAG_SECURE + Web capture shield + Home Pass live clock)
Unified Form Builder across Add/Edit, Registration, Profile, ID Cards, Receipts & CSV Exports
Status-gated seat selection & single canonical Library amenities everywhere

adminFeatures.title: Admin/Student Notification Isolation & Student Screenshot Shield
adminFeatures.description: Strict role fencing stops student admission/desk/announcement alerts from reaching Admin devices, while Student Portal Screenshot Protection settings stay controlled from Admin without blocking Admin screenshots.

adminFeatures.title: Full Custom Field Parity Across Add, Edit, Cards & Exports
adminFeatures.description: Custom and built-in fields (Text, Long Text, Dropdown, Multi-Select, Date, Toggle, Regex Presets) now render live across Admin Add/Edit, Registration, Profile, ID Cards, Receipts, and CSV/Excel exports.

adminFeatures.title: Status-Gated Public Seat Maps & Single Amenity Catalog
adminFeatures.description: Reserved, Maintenance, and Occupied desks restrict booking on public/student seat maps, while Library Profile amenities act as the single canonical source of truth everywhere.

adminFeatures.title: Unified Version-Keyed What's New & Dynamic APK/Web Links
adminFeatures.description: What's New highlights hydrate live per version across Web, APK, update banners, and the /download portal with verified release binary links.

studentFeatures.title: Screenshot-Shielded Smart Pass & Clean Student Alerts
studentFeatures.description: Digital Pass, Receipts, and Payment screens enforce screenshot protection with a live verification clock ticker on your Home Pass, while notifications deliver strictly student-relevant updates.

studentFeatures.title: Upgraded Admission Forms & Full Profile Editing
studentFeatures.description: Registration & Profile Update forms now adapt dynamically with toggles, multi-select tags, custom validations, accurate blood group display, and Digital Pass custom tags.

studentFeatures.title: Clear Status-Gated Seat Selection & Genuine Amenities
studentFeatures.description: See exact hall availability (Reserved, Maintenance, Occupied vs Available) and genuine library-equipped amenities without accidental booking triggers.

studentFeatures.title: Version-Accurate Release Notes Across Web & App
studentFeatures.description: See the exact new features added in each build right inside What's New and when reloading a fresh web or APK release.
